data.title: Arista Says Its AI Business Will Double to $7 Billion
data.description: Arista's CEO just handed Wall Street a 2027 revenue target that blew past consensus by nearly $2 billion, but buried inside that bullish call is a slower-growing business that raises real questions about whether the AI boom can carry the whole company.
